UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated developer profile and cumulative Pomodoro focus metrics.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every update.

SavedConfig.title: SavedConfig
SavedConfig.description: User-saved editor JSON configuration snapshot synced to cloud.

keysCount.description: Number of top-level keys in the configuration.

FocusSessionLog.title: FocusSessionLog
FocusSessionLog.description: Completed Pomodoro work interval log entry.

presetName.description: Focus preset name (e.g. CLASSIC, DEEP_WORK, SPRINT, CUSTOM).

ActiveTimerState.title: ActiveTimerState
ActiveTimerState.description: Persisted active Pomodoro session state (task name, remaining seconds, phase, preset) for resuming across app launches.

taskName.description: Current focus task title entered by the user.

phase.description: Active FocusPhase enum name (FOCUS or BREAK).

totalSeconds.description: Total duration of the active phase in seconds.

remainingSeconds.description: Seconds remaining in the active phase.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every update.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user developer profile and focus totals, isolated strictly to the signed-in owner.

/users/{userId}/configs/{configId}.description: Cloud-synced JSON editor configurations owned by the user.

/users/{userId}/focus_sessions/{sessionI.description: Completed Pomodoro focus session history owned by the user.

/users/{userId}/active_timer/{timerId}.description: Resumable active Pomodoro timer state owned by the user.
